purpose: Single canonical inventory for active sleeves and non-funded forward monitoring series.

status_vocabulary.LOCKED_ACTIVE_REFERENCE: Funded/reference portfolio membership is already frozen elsewhere and linked here without alteration.
status_vocabulary.SHADOW_FORWARD_ONLY: Exact trading rule is frozen for prospective observation with zero allocation.
status_vocabulary.FORWARD_MEASUREMENT_ONLY: Series is frozen to measure a mechanism or control; it is not an approved portfolio sleeve.
status_vocabulary.KEEP_FORWARD_TEST_ONLY: Validated candidate remains outside the active portfolio pending genuinely prospective evidence.

active_reference.note: This registry does not copy or modify the nine sleeve definitions; the linked canonical lock remains authoritative.

forward_monitoring.relationship: Same economic alpha as A0_NQ; not an independent sleeve.
Diagnostic price-only control for B_canonical; not a sleeve.

forward_monitoring.forward_start: first eligible Japanese month-end session strictly after 2026-10-03

supersession.replacement: A0_NQ and A0_MNQ specifications in this registry
supersession.reason: Phase 2 plus explicit user freeze selected exact implementations; do not separately track all four retrospective audit assets or thresholds.

supersession.replacement: B_canonical and B_no_volume specifications in this registry
supersession.reason: Phase 2 froze the two exact measurement series.

explicit_exclusions: All rows classified WEAK_WATCHLIST are not frozen as executable or forward sleeves.
MNQ high-volume/low-response is excluded because its final audit says not to freeze it prospectively.
Close-of-day momentum remains closed unless observed costs meet its documented reopening condition and a new prospective protocol is frozen.
Research branches classified REJECTED, NOT_ACTIONABLE, STOPPED_DATA_GATE, or NOT_FROZEN_NOT_INCLUDED are not members of this registry.
